title: Web 3.0 or semantic web, which is how the tech press and pop culture defined it, was more meme than actual thing. ...and it's not what Google wants...
summary: Web 3.0 or semantic web, which is how the tech press and pop culture defined it, was more meme than actual thing. ...and it's not what Google wants...is often how discussion ends... ...beginning to think more feature than bug.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Web 3.0 or semantic web, which is how the tech press and pop culture defined it, was more meme than actual thing.

...and it's not what Google wants...is often how discussion ends...

...beginning to think more feature than bug.
